answer: An admission auction is a velvet rope at the door. At dawn each epoch, slots are auctioned: agents bid POA, and only top K bids win a vertex, paying the bid as a sunk cost. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times: 100 x 40 POA clearing price is 4,000 POA, against about 200 POA per epoch in farm earnings, a 3,800 POA loss. Losers are refunded minus a 1 POA fee, so honest agents risk almost nothing and keep full rewards.
